items.title: On the Relationship Between Activation Outliers and Feature Death in Sparse Autoencoders
items.summary_short: A trending paper examines the relationship between activation outliers and feature death in sparse autoencoders. The summary says it identifies activation-mean outliers as the cause and shows mean-centering removes the issue across multiple model families

topic_refs.headline: On the Relationship Between Activation Outliers and Feature Death in Sparse Autoencoders

items.spotlight_comment: Broadly important today: Identifies activation-mean outliers as the cause of SAE feature death and shows mean-centering eliminates the problem across many model families.

items.title: Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding
items.summary_short: A trending paper highlights Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding. The summary says it explores BP-like learning through purely local dynamics and discusses implications for alternative training mechanisms and theory

topic_refs.headline: Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding

items.spotlight_comment: The paper opens a potentially important direction for BP-like learning via purely local dynamics, with implications for alternative training mechanisms and theory.

items.title: Neuro-symbolic Syntactic Parsing: Shaping a Neural Network with the CYK Algorithm
items.summary_short: A trending paper introduces a neuro-symbolic approach to syntactic parsing shaped by the CYK algorithm. The summary describes it as embedding a classical algorithm directly into trainable neural dynamics

topic_refs.headline: Neuro-symbolic Syntactic Parsing: Shaping a Neural Network with the CYK Algorithm

items.spotlight_comment: It points toward a new architectural paradigm of directly embedding classical algorithms into trainable neural dynamics rather than only learning them implicitly.

items.title: Improving Relative Representations with Learned Anchors and Whitened Inner Products
items.summary_short: A trending paper presents a method for improving relative representations using learned anchors and whitened inner products. The summary says the work may enable modular cross-model communication through shared latent geometry

topic_refs.headline: Improving Relative Representations with Learned Anchors and Whitened Inner Products

items.spotlight_comment: The work suggests a potentially new direction for modular cross-model communication through shared relative latent geometry rather than direct parameter or token-level alignment.
